title: Drive appDataFolder manifest.json
description: Storage layout (schema 1): appDataFolder is FLAT. Each file's Drive `name` is its logical path (e.g. "entries/2026/11/<id>.json", "photos/<id>.jpg", "settings.json") - no Drive folders, so two devices can never create duplicate folders. Every file carries appProperties {entityId, kind} (kind = entry|photo|settings|entitlement|manifest); look files up by appProperties entityId, not by name (an entry's name changes when its date changes). Readers seeing a higher schema than they know must not write.
